meta.dominanceDefinition: Right-dominant: the PDA (SYNTAX 4) and the posterolateral branches (16a-c) arise from the RCA.
meta.isocentre: volume centroid of the convex hull of the BodyParts3D 4.0 heart (ventricular wall, atrial walls, ascending aorta, pulmonary trunk, coronary arteries); BP3D coords (x,y,z)=[np.float64(20.026), np.float64(-123.4), np.float64(1226.978)]; X=x-x0, Y=z-z0, Z=-(y-y0)
meta.source: Derived from BodyParts3D 4.0 whole-body model (c) The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), CC BY 4.0. Centrelines extracted from the 4.0 coronary meshes and laid on the 4.0 heart; missing vessels synthesised. See docs/ANATOMY-NOTES.md and public/anatomy/ATTRIBUTION.md.

vessels.name: Left main coronary artery
vessels.source: ImageCAS-X primary-cohort mean LM course from the re-modelled left sinus to the CT-mean bifurcation point (shared by the three files)

vessels.name: Left anterior descending artery
vessels.source: ImageCAS-X mean LAD positions to 110 mm, then the 4.0 apical course ending in a short wrap 14 mm past the apex; faired and seated in this heart's (fitted) anterior interventricular groove

vessels.name: Left circumflex artery
vessels.source: ImageCAS-X mean LCx positions to 40 mm, then the 4.0 course (FJ2649), continued 10 mm toward the apex on the inferolateral wall

vessels.name: Right coronary artery
vessels.source: ImageCAS-X primary-cohort mean RCA positions from the re-modelled right sinus, then to this heart's crux (shared)

vessels.name: Posterolateral branch (trunk)

vessels.name: Posterior descending artery
vessels.source: ImageCAS-X mean R-PDA course from this heart's crux (shared)
